errors.text: The proposed protective Cr/Ti-rich oxide scale is chemically impossible as stated because the Mg-Al-Ti-V-Fe-Co alloy contains no chromium.
The central Ti/V-rich Laves-phase mediator is unsupported for this alloy; it is extrapolated from a compositionally and thermally distinct Cr-Mo-Nb-W-V system.

The hypothesis predicts linear oxidation kinetics while also invoking a lower parabolic rate constant, which is internally inconsistent and conflicts with the target diffusion-controlled parabolic behavior.
It replaces the relevant barrier oxides AlV2O4, FeAl2O4, and FeTiO3 with speculative intermetallics and chromia-like scales.
